supportingSources.label: District 82 Baby Pac-Man gameplay and strategy

strategy.summary: Use a lower maze escape tunnel to enter Pinball Mode. Complete T-U-N-N-E-L for permanent side-tunnel speed, then complete a P-A-C-M-A-N column and shoot its side saucer to return without closing both lower maze exits.

steps.text: In the first maze, clear safe dots near the lower area. Enter either lower escape tunnel when the ghosts approach.
modeNotes: Maze Mode: Baby Pac-Man starts in the video maze. A lower escape tunnel transfers play to the physical pinball field.

steps.text: During the first physical visit, prioritize the far-right T-U-N-N-E-L lane and right saucer.
modeNotes: Pinball Mode: Physical shots build tunnel speed, power pills, fruit, and extra lives. A qualified saucer or center drain returns to the maze.
Tunnel Speed: Completing T-U-N-N-E-L raises Baby Pac-Man's permanent side-tunnel speed by one, to Speed 8.

steps.text: Hit the yellow center drop targets. Hit the captive ball only when its rebound is controlled.
modeNotes: Power-pill columns: Each yellow target adds one P-A-C-M-A-N letter to its matching column. A complete six-letter column places one power pill in the maze.
Captive-ball award: It is the fast route to the two outer power-pill columns.

steps.text: Use the inner-left lane to equalize columns 1 and 2. Use the inner-right lane to equalize columns 3 and 4.
modeNotes: Equalizer: The lower column rises to the higher adjacent value. If one paired column is complete, the other completes too.

steps.text: When a power pill is ready, shoot its matching side saucer.
modeNotes: Controlled maze return: The left saucer uses power-pill columns 1 or 2. The right saucer uses columns 3 or 4. The chosen lower maze exit stays open. The opposite exit closes.

steps.text: In the maze, use the faster side tunnel to separate Baby Pac-Man from the ghosts. Save unused early power pills for later mazes.
Return to Pinball Mode when no power pills remain or the ghosts close in. Repeat tunnel-speed and power-pill progress.

fallback.title: Power pills before speed
fallback.when: Use this plan when the far-right T-U-N-N-E-L lane is unsafe.

steps.text: Hit the safest yellow drop target.
Use an inner equalizer lane to copy progress to its paired column.
Hit the captive ball only when its rebound is controlled.
Complete one P-A-C-M-A-N column. Exit through its matching saucer before a center drain.
Use the power pill only when it prevents a life loss or clears a dangerous maze section.

alternatives.title: Extra Life at the blue target
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the center target rebounds are safe and Extra Life is enabled.

steps.text: Hit a yellow center target. The blue center target rises for a short time.
Hit the blue target to light one center arrow.
Repeat until all five arrows are lit.
A complete set awards an extra Baby when the operator setting permits it.
Stop when the shorter blue-target window makes the rebound unsafe.

alternatives.title: Fruit upgrade
alternatives.when: Use this plan only after tunnel speed and power pills are sufficient.

steps.text: Roll through the far-left F-R-U-I-T-S lane or use the left saucer to add a letter.
Complete F-R-U-I-T-S to raise the maze fruit to the next value.
Eat the fruit in Maze Mode for the larger award.
Before chasing another F-R-U-I-T-S letter, complete the needed T-U-N-N-E-L letters and P-A-C-M-A-N column.
Complete T-U-N-N-E-L to raise permanent Tunnel Speed.
Carry unused power pills into harder mazes.
Clear every dot in the current maze.
The three maze layouts repeat with harder colors, faster play, and later invisible interior walls.

techniques.name: Power-column equalizer
techniques.instruction: Use the inner-left lane for columns 1 and 2. Use the inner-right lane for columns 3 and 4. Build one column high, then copy it to the other.

techniques.name: Controlled saucer exit
techniques.instruction: After a power pill is complete, shoot its left or right saucer instead of allowing a center drain. This keeps one lower maze exit available.

cautions.issue: A center drain closes both lower maze exits.
cautions.response: Return through a qualified saucer whenever possible. After a drain, Pinball Mode stays locked until the maze is cleared or a life is lost.

cautions.issue: A qualified saucer ends Pinball Mode.
cautions.response: Choose the side that matches a completed power-pill column. Finish the needed physical-playfield work before you enter it.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Use a lower maze escape tunnel to enter Pinball Mode.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Complete T-U-N-N-E-L to raise permanent Tunnel Speed.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Power pills before speed: Use this plan when the far-right T-U-N-N-E-L lane is unsafe.

strategy.simpleOverview: Baby Pac-Man alternates between a video maze and a physical playfield that supplies tunnel speed and power pills. Escape through a lower maze tunnel, complete T-U-N-N-E-L for permanent speed, then finish a P-A-C-M-A-N column and enter its matching saucer. Save power pills for later mazes.
strategy.overview: Baby Pac-Man uses Pinball Mode to prepare future maze survival. Enter through a lower maze tunnel, improve permanent Tunnel Speed, and complete paired P-A-C-M-A-N columns for power pills. Return through the matching saucer before both lower exits close, then spend pills only when they prevent a lost life.
